purpose: Operational source-access and media-display policy for The Holding Realty. This registry is not a legal opinion; it records conservative product rules based on the latest reviewed source terms and should be re-reviewed before commercial launch or automated ingestion expansion.

defaultPolicy.facts: store only source-linked factual observations with provenance
defaultPolicy.missing: never coerce missing values to zero
defaultPolicy.automation: manual verification or protocol-native/onchain observation until a source-specific automated-access right is clear
defaultPolicy.media: exact third-party media is link-only until display rights are clear; use The Holding-owned or neutral non-deceptive visuals otherwise
defaultPolicy.commercialization: re-review terms and obtain permission/partnership where required before monetized routing or commercial API use

Lofty.automationReason: Current Terms prohibit data mining, robots, scraping and similar extraction methods from Lofty Products.
Lofty.currentRealtyMode: manually verified factual market observation + source link; exact source photos retained only as research provenance and not required for rendering
Lofty.commercializationGate: terms/permission review before automated catalog ingestion or commercial reuse

Reental.automationReason: Current Terms restrict commercial collection of information/content for services that clearly compete with Reental.
Reental.currentRealtyMode: manually verified factual observation + source link; no bulk mirroring of protected site content
Reental.commercializationGate: written-permission/partnership review recommended before scaled automated or commercial use

OpenSea.automationReason: Current Terms prohibit unauthorized automated scraping; commercial API/API Data use requires express written permission.
OpenSea.currentRealtyMode: source-linked observations only; protocol/onchain evidence preferred where reproducible
OpenSea.commercializationGate: written permission required for monetized OpenSea API/API Data use under current terms

The Sandbox.automationReason: Current Terms restrict automated searches/requests and scraping/mining from the site, subject to limited search-engine exceptions.
The Sandbox.currentRealtyMode: source-linked market observation; protocol/onchain state preferred for future automation
The Sandbox.commercializationGate: permission/partnership review before scaled site-derived ingestion

Public blockchain.automationReason: Public ledger state is observed at protocol level; any hosted RPC, indexer or API used to access it may have separate terms and rate limits.
Public blockchain.currentRealtyMode: preferred source for ownership, transfers, token IDs and other reproducible onchain facts
Public blockchain.commercializationGate: review RPC/indexer/API terms separately from blockchain data rights
